generation.scope: Every finite-dimensional simple with a vertex of dimension four on a regular finite window has dimension four at every vertex, without PI assumptions. Improved five-dimensional restriction ranks, simultaneous middle vertices avoiding a corner, and the rank-two middle product bound at dimension six give a finite dimension-profile proof. Five-matrix identities at only one designated corner now imply the full degree-32 criterion and index two or four.
